findings.issue: `hinted.length === 0 ||` is implied by `decisions.length < 2` (any hand with a user decision opens/hides Hint at index 0, so hinted is non-empty whenever decisions >= 1).
findings.evidence: playHand's callback returns true for index 0 unconditionally.
findings.fix: Optional: drop the `hinted.length === 0 ||` clause, or keep it as a readable guard.

findings.issue: The river-entry-with-tag wrap (A-3) is covered only by the CSS rule; no test renders a 5-card river entry with a tag live. The spec accepts this (section 7).
findings.evidence: SPEC-05's overflow check runs on a flop-hinted hand.
findings.fix: None required; a follow-up could add an overflow check on a river-hinted live entry.

summary: ReviewPanel renders the verdict group and the hinted tag exactly as specified; CSS matches the spec values and .grade-badge has no other users. Fixture tests assert stored hinted flags and per-entry tag counts through the real hint state machine; AC#4 asserts hand.userDecisions.length >= 2 and >= 2 entries (fixture) and skips 1-decision hands then asserts entries.length >= 2 (live). The wrap change only alters layout when the row overflows; untagged rows have the same widths as before, and no locked test measures entry-top row geometry. Reviewer ran review-hinted, review, review-numbers, review-header and review-shown e2e specs: 24/24 pass in Chromium and WebKit. No BLOCKER/MAJOR.
